items.name: Exp. Share
items.desc: Entregue a Letter para o Steven na Granite Cave. Depois volte a Rustboro e fale com o Mr. Stone na Devon Corporation.

en.desc: Deliver the Letter to Steven in Granite Cave, then return to Rustboro and talk to Mr. Stone at the Devon Corporation.

items.name: Macho Brace
items.desc: Vença a família Winstrate na Rota 111 (Norte de Mauville) e fale com a mãe da família.

en.desc: Beat the Winstrate family on Route 111 (north of Mauville) and talk to the mother afterwards.

items.name: Amulet Coin
items.desc: Entregue pela sua mãe (no seu quarto em Littleroot Town) após vencer o Norman (5º Ginásio).

en.desc: Ask your mother for it in your room in Littleroot Town, after beating Norman (5th Gym).

items.name: Master Ball
items.desc: Captura garantida, uma só por jogo. Fica no Hideout da equipe vilã (Magma em Ruby, Aqua em Sapphire e Emerald) — em R/S a entrada é selada depois de vencer Tate & Liza. Também sai acertando os 5 dígitos na Loteria da Lilycove Department Store.

en.desc: A guaranteed catch, one per game. It sits in the villainous team’s hideout (Magma in Ruby, Aqua in Sapphire and Emerald) - in R/S the entrance is sealed after you beat Tate & Liza. It can also come from matching all 5 digits in the Lilycove Department Store lottery.

items.name: Everstone
items.desc: Impede a evolução por nível. Fica na Granite Cave. Em Emerald ele também passa a nature: segurado pela mãe (ou Ditto) na Day Care, dá 50% de chance do filhote herdar a nature dela — em Ruby e Sapphire essa mecânica não existe.

en.desc: Stops evolution by level. Found in Granite Cave. In Emerald it also passes nature: held by the mother (or a Ditto) at the Day Care, it gives a 50% chance the baby inherits her nature - a mechanic that does not exist in Ruby and Sapphire.

items.name: Old Rod
items.desc: Fale com o pescador ao lado do Ginásio de Dewford Town.

en.desc: From the fisherman next to the Dewford Town Gym.

items.name: Good Rod
items.desc: Fale com o pescador no lado leste do rio na Rota 118 (precisa usar Surf partindo de Mauville).

en.desc: From the fisherman on the north side of Route 118 (you need Surf from Mauville).

items.name: Super Rod
items.desc: Fale com o pescador dentro da casa em Mossdeep City.

en.desc: From the fisherman inside the house in Mossdeep City.

items.name: Mach / Acro Bike
items.desc: Pegue com o Rydel na loja de Bicicletas em Mauville City. Você pode trocar o tipo da bicicleta falando com ele depois.

en.desc: Free from Rydel’s Cycles in Mauville City. You can swap between the two whenever you like, at no cost.

items.name: Itemfinder
items.desc: Dada pelo Rival (May/Brendan) na Rota 110 após você vencê-lo em batalha.

en.desc: From Mr. Stone at the Devon Corporation in Rustboro, after delivering the Devon Goods.

items.name: Go-Goggles
items.desc: Recebido da May/Brendan em Lavaridge Town após você derrotar a Flannery (4º Ginásio).

en.desc: Given by the Devon researcher after you clear the Weather Institute on Route 119.

items.name: Devon Scope
items.desc: Revela Pokémon invisíveis. Entregue pelo Steven na ponte norte da Route 120 — é o que libera a passagem para o Ginásio de Fortree e permite batalhar os Kecleon escondidos nas Routes 119 e 120.

en.desc: Reveals invisible Pokemon. Steven hands it over on the northern bridge of Route 120 - it is what opens the way to the Fortree Gym and lets you battle the hidden Kecleon on Routes 119 and 120.

items.name: Water / Fire / Leaf Stone
items.desc: Podem ser trocadas por Shards (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green) com o Treasure Hunter na Rota 124.

en.desc: Trade Shards (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green) with the Treasure Hunter on Route 124.

items.name: Moon / Sun Stone
items.desc: Moon Stone é encontrada na Meteor Falls. Sun Stone está no Space Center em Mossdeep City.

en.desc: The Moon Stone is in Meteor Falls. The Sun Stone is at the Space Center in Mossdeep City.

items.name: Metal Coat
items.desc: Pode ser encontrado equipado em Magnemite e Magneton selvagens no New Mauville (5% de chance).

en.desc: Held by wild Magnemite and Magneton in New Mauville (5% chance).

items.name: King's Rock
items.desc: Dada por um garoto passeando próximo à casa do Steven em Mossdeep City.

en.desc: Given by a boy walking near Steven’s house in Mossdeep City.

items.name: Dragon Scale
items.desc: Pode ser encontrada equipada em Bagon e Horsea selvagens (5% de chance).

en.desc: Held by wild Bagon and Horsea (5% chance).

items.name: Deep Sea Tooth & Scale
items.desc: Troque o Scanner encontrado no Abandoned Ship com o Capitão Stern em Slateport. Você só pode escolher um dos dois.

en.desc: Trade the Scanner found on the Abandoned Ship with Captain Stern in Slateport. You may only pick one of the two.

items.name: Up-Grade
items.desc: Não está disponível naturalmente em Hoenn. É necessário transferir através de troca de Pokémon FireRed/LeafGreen.

en.desc: Not obtainable in Hoenn. It has to be traded over from FireRed/LeafGreen.

items.name: Pokéblock Case
items.desc: Guarda até 40 Pokéblocks do Berry Blender e é o passe de entrada da Safari Zone de Hoenn. Em Ruby/Sapphire vem de uma menina no Contest Hall de Slateport; em Emerald, da recepcionista à esquerda no Contest Hall de Lilycove.

en.desc: Holds up to 40 Pokeblocks from the Berry Blender, and is the admission pass for the Hoenn Safari Zone. In Ruby/Sapphire a little girl in the Slateport Contest Hall gives it; in Emerald, the left receptionist in the Lilycove Contest Hall.

items.name: Wailmer Pail
items.desc: Regador das berries — regar aumenta a colheita. Fica com a irmã do meio na floricultura Pretty Petal, na Route 104. Em Emerald é ele que molha a árvore falsa da Battle Frontier e revela o Sudowoodo.

en.desc: The berry watering can - watering increases the harvest. The middle sister at the Pretty Petal flower shop on Route 104 hands it over. In Emerald it is also what waters the fake tree in the Battle Frontier and reveals Sudowoodo.

items.name: Coin Case
items.desc: Guarda até 9.999 fichas do Game Corner. Em Mauville City, trocando uma Harbor Mail com a mulher da casa ao lado da Poké Mart.

en.desc: Holds up to 9,999 Game Corner coins. In Mauville City, by trading a Harbor Mail with the woman in the house next to the Poke Mart.

items.name: Soot Sack
items.desc: Recolhe cinza vulcânica ao andar pela Route 113 e pelo Jagged Pass, até 9.999 passos. Entregue pelo dono da Vidraçaria (Glass Workshop) da Route 113, que troca a cinza por itens.

en.desc: Collects volcanic ash as you walk through Route 113 and Jagged Pass, up to 9,999 steps. Given by the owner of the Glass Workshop on Route 113, who trades the ash for items.

items.name: Exp. Share
items.desc: Fale com o ajudante do Prof. Oak no portão leste da Fuchsia City (Rota 15). É necessário ter 50 Pokémon registrados na Pokédex.

en.desc: Talk to Prof. Oak’s aide at the east gate of Fuchsia City (Route 15). You need 50 Pokemon registered in the Pokedex.

items.name: Macho Brace
items.desc: Use o Itemfinder no exato local onde Giovanni estava no Ginásio de Viridian City, após derrotá-lo.

en.desc: Use the Itemfinder in the Rocket Warehouse on Five Island (Sevii), after the post-game story.

items.name: Amulet Coin
items.desc: Fale com o ajudante do Prof. Oak no portão da Rota 16 (Oeste de Celadon). É necessário ter 40 Pokémon capturados.

en.desc: On Route 16, on the ground west of the Snorlax that blocks the path.

items.name: Master Ball
items.desc: Captura garantida, uma só por jogo. O presidente da Silph Co. entrega depois que você derrota o Giovanni no prédio.

en.desc: A guaranteed catch, one per game. The Silph Co. president hands it over after you beat Giovanni in the building.

items.name: Everstone
items.desc: Impede a evolução por nível. O ajudante do Prof. Oak no Centro Pokémon da Route 10 entrega depois de 20 espécies registradas.

en.desc: Stops evolution by level. Prof. Oak’s aide at the Route 10 Pokemon Center gives it after 20 species are registered.

items.name: Old Rod
items.desc: Fale com o Fishing Guru dentro do Pokémon Center de Vermilion City.

en.desc: From the Fishing Guru in the house on the west side of Vermilion City.

items.name: Good Rod
items.desc: Fale com o irmão do Fishing Guru na casa em Fuchsia City.

en.desc: From the Fishing Guru’s brother in the house on Route 12, south of Lavender.

items.name: Super Rod
items.desc: Fale com o irmão mais velho na casa na Rota 12 (sul de Lavender Town).

en.desc: From the Fishing Guru’s older brother in the house on Route 12, near the Silence Bridge.

items.name: Bicycle
items.desc: Pegue o Bike Voucher com o presidente do Pokémon Fan Club em Vermilion City, e troque na Bike Shop em Cerulean City.

en.desc: Take the Bike Voucher from the Pokemon Fan Club in Vermilion to the Bike Shop in Cerulean.

items.name: Itemfinder
items.desc: Fale com o ajudante do Prof. Oak no portão da Rota 11. É necessário ter 30 Pokémon registrados.

en.desc: From Prof. Oak’s aide on Route 11, after registering 30 Pokemon.

items.name: Silph Scope
items.desc: Derrote o Giovanni no esconderijo da Equipe Rocket em Celadon City (Game Corner).

en.desc: Found on the 3rd floor of the Rocket Hideout under the Celadon Game Corner. It reveals the ghosts in Pokemon Tower.

items.name: Poké Flute
items.desc: Acorda os Snorlax que bloqueiam as Routes 12 e 16, e em batalha tira o sono de todos os Pokémon em campo. Vem do Mr. Fuji, na Volunteer Pokémon House de Lavender Town, depois de expulsar a Equipe Rocket da Pokémon Tower.

en.desc: Wakes the Snorlax blocking Routes 12 and 16, and in battle cures every Pokemon on the field of sleep. From Mr. Fuji at the Volunteer Pokemon House in Lavender Town, after driving Team Rocket out of Pokemon Tower.

items.name: VS Seeker
items.desc: Aponta os treinadores da área que querem revanche. Com uma moça no Centro Pokémon de Vermilion City. Recarrega a cada 100 passos.

en.desc: Points out trainers in the area who want a rematch. From a girl in the Vermilion City Pokemon Center. It recharges every 100 steps.

items.name: Evolution Stones
items.desc: Fire, Water, Thunder, e Leaf Stones podem ser compradas no Celadon Department Store (4º Andar) por $2100.

en.desc: Fire, Water, Thunder and Leaf Stones can be bought at the Celadon Department Store (4F) for $2,100.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.desc: Encontrada no Mt. Moon (duas cópias) e no Rocket Hideout.

en.desc: Found in Mt. Moon (two of them) and in the Rocket Hideout.

items.name: Metal Coat
items.desc: Recebida no Memorial Pillar (Five Island) como recompensa.

en.desc: Received at the Memorial Pillar (Five Island) as a reward.

items.name: King's Rock
items.desc: Encontrada no Sevault Canyon (Seven Island) e pode vir equipada em Slowbro/Poliwhirl selvagens.

en.desc: Found in Sevault Canyon (Seven Island), and held by wild Slowbro and Poliwhirl.

items.name: Dragon Scale
items.desc: Encontrada no Water Path (Six Island) e pode vir equipada em Horsea, Seadra, Dratini e Dragonair selvagens.

en.desc: Found on the Water Path (Six Island), and held by wild Horsea, Seadra, Dratini and Dragonair.

items.name: Up-Grade
items.desc: Encontrada no Rocket Warehouse (Five Island).

en.desc: Found in the Rocket Warehouse (Five Island).

items.name: Tea
items.desc: Entregue a um dos guardas de Saffron e todos os portões da cidade liberam. Está com o gerente na suíte do Celadon Mansion (1º andar).

en.desc: Give it to one of the Saffron guards and every gate into the city opens. It is with the manager in the Celadon Mansion suite (1F).

items.name: Coin Case
items.desc: Guarda até 9.999 fichas do Game Corner. Com um homem no restaurante de Celadon City.

en.desc: Holds up to 9,999 Game Corner coins. With a man in the Celadon City restaurant.
